title: Cheetah vs the fastest human

scenes.headline: Not even close
scenes.source: Smithsonian's National Zoo; Bolt 2009 laser data

scenes.headline: per stride, four strides a second
scenes.body: The catch: a full sprint lasts only about 20 seconds.

caption:
Animal athletes, episode 1.

Usain Bolt peaked at about 12.3 m/s in his 2009 world-record 100 m, while a cheetah can hold its top speed for only about 274 m.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo; laser analysis of the 2009 Berlin 100 m (PMC). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Fitness 'stats and progress' format as animal vs human, every number sourced; uses a range for cheetah speed as the Smithsonian does.
